title: Schedule of Reporting Cushions on Credit Balance Refunds
content:
On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, a reporting cushion is kept back from a credit balance refund as a share of the credit balance plus the appeal interest allowance. The share follows the late report penalties booked on the account within the class's penalty abatement lookback quarters — 8 quarters in every financing class — counted as three months each, that is 24 months.

| Late report penalties booked within 24 months | Share kept back |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.2 |
| Exactly one | 0.1 |
| None | Nothing is kept back |

**Counting.** The 24-month window is counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the entry dates of the late report penalties in the account's balance history.

**What the share is taken on.** The credit balance and the appeal interest allowance added together; the cushion is that sum multiplied by the share.

## Illustrations (hypothetical credit balance of USD 1,000.00 and allowance of USD 43.40)

| Late report penalties in 24 months | Sum | Cushion kept back | Remaining |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 1,043.40 | 0.00 | 1,043.40 |
| One, booked 10 months before the request | 1,043.40 | 104.34 | 939.06 |
| Two, booked 10 and 20 months before | 1,043.40 | 208.68 | 834.72 |
| One booked 10 months before and one 27 months before | 1,043.40 | 104.34 | 939.06 |

In the last row the penalty booked 27 months before lies outside the 24 months and is not counted.
